title: Search a Rotated Sorted List
prompt:
A list of distinct integers was sorted in ascending order and then rotated at some unknown pivot (for example [1,2,3,4,5,6] might become [4,5,6,1,2,3]). Given this slice `nums` and a value `target`, return `Some(index)` of target in nums, or `None` if it is absent.

Signature: `fn search_rotated(nums: &[i32], target: i32) -> Option<usize>`

Your solution should run in O(log n) time.

Example:
  search_rotated(&[4, 5, 6, 1, 2, 3], 2) -> Some(4)
  search_rotated(&[4, 5, 6, 1, 2, 3], 7) -> None
